answer.summary: Approve the reclass. Line SS262163 for $64,415.70 (AP clerk temporary staff, May 2026) was booked to 6510 Professional Fees – Consulting, but it belongs in 6530 Contract Labour, where this supplier's work normally goes. Skillhaus Solutions (V2443) is a contract labour vendor whose default account is 6530 and cost centre CC9110. Same-description lines from Skillhaus and other staffing vendors are all in 6530, and the $125,500.50 invoice is split between 6510 and 6530, which points to a one-line keying error. The proposed October entry moves exactly $64,415.70 from 6510 to 6530 within CC9110, the debit and credit match, and posting in October is correct because September is closed.
